summary: Contestants apply advanced accounting principles to execute the accounting cycle, record complex transactions, and prepare and analyze financial statements in compliance with GAAP and industry standards. The event includes both objective and application evaluation, and is open to any postsecondary division contestant. Contestants must follow strict equipment and material guidelines during the competition.
time_limits: no more than ten (10) minutes for orientation
no more than ninety (90) minutes for testing
no more than ten (10) minutes for wrap-up
what_to_bring: Published and/or unpublished non-electronic written reference materials
competencies: Execute and articulate each phase in the accounting cycle
Prepare, interpret, and analyze interim and end-of-period financial statements and reports for service, merchandising, and digital business models using accounting platforms.
Apply accounting principles to assess and report assets, liabilities, and equity values in compliance with GAAP
Apply periodic and perpetual inventory systems using industry-standard valuation methods and software tools
Record and explain adjusting entries for accruals, depreciation, prepaids, and deferrals
Account for disposal and systematic allocation of long-term asset costs through depreciation, depletion, and amortization
Apply accounting principles and analyze equity transactions across various business entities
Analyze financial statements using ratio analysis and key performance indicators
Calculate interest and maturity values of long-term liabilities using financial formulas and software tools
Calculate and record bond transactions using straight-line and effective interest methods in compliance with GAAP
Record merchandise transactions using gross and net methods in accordance with revenue recognition standards
judging_notes: No equipment, supplies, or materials other than those specified for an event will be allowed in the testing area

Previous Business Professionals of America tests and/or sample tests or facsimiles (handwritten, photocopied or keyed) may not be taken into the testing area. Violation of this rule will result in disqualification.
Electronic devices will be monitored according to ACT standards. Contestants who violate this rule will be disqualified.
AI Policy Level 1 No AI Allowed
eligibility_notes: Any postsecondary division contestant may enter this application event.
Contestants may not enter College Accounting and Advanced College Accounting in the same year.
